[size=4]Original Description[/size]

I create this mod with Content Patcher.

I don't like combat at all. I always die in combat.

So I make all the normal monsters "harmless", which means the damage to HP is set to zero.

And also I would like to speed up killing. So I decreased the health of all monsters, to 10% of their original health value.

Note: Using this mod [b]does not mean the HP is locked[/b].
Skipping floors with cavern, hit by fire balls, and combatting in mutant bug lair, would still cause damage to the HP.
